snippet.title: Paul's Lost Remains - Short Horror Game
snippet.description:
You are a camper who wakes up in the middle of the night to a horrifying scream. You rush out of your tent and find that your friend Paul is missing, and there is blood on the ground. You decide to search for him in the dark and creepy forest, hoping that he is still alive. But as you explore the forest, you find his severed body parts scattered around, and you have to collect them and put them on a cross in the center of the forest. What will happen when you complete the cross? Find out in this short horror game that will test your nerves and challenge your sanity.

Link: https://nannings.itch.io/pauls-lost-remains
